title: Coates Hire Operations Pty Limited - proposed acquisition of Tru-Blu Hire Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Coates Hire Operations Pty Limited proposed to acquire the assets of Tru-Blu Hire Australia Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition in the context of: - state markets for the supply of general equipment hire in South Australia and the Northern Territory; and - regional markets for the supply of general equipment hire in the north and south of Western Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any market. Factors informing this conclusion included: - the existence of a number of competitors, both general and specialist equipment hire companies, in each market; - Tru-Blu's limited presence in each market; and - barriers to expansion are relatively low.
